Major spare parts, if required, shall be replaced only with prior approval of the Inst itute and as per applicable contract terms. 7. Service records shall be maintained and submitted to the concerned section after each visit. 6. Contract Period: The Annual Rate Contract (ARC) shall be awarded for a minimu m period of three (03) years. 2. Routine Maintenance Visits: The service provider shall carry out a minimum of two (02) routine preventive maintenance visits per year for all equipment covered under the contract. 3. Emergency Breakdown Visits: The service provider shall provide two (02) addit ional emergency breakdown visits per year, as and when required by the Institute, without any additional service-visit charges. 4. Commencement and Validity: The contract shall remain valid for three (03) ye ars commencing from the date of the first AMC service visit. 5. Payment Terms: Payment shall be released twice a year on a half-yearly basis, a gainst submission of bills/invoices and subject to satisfactory performance of the m aintenance services, duly certified by the concerned authority of the Institute. 6. Annual Calibration: Routine preventive maintenance shall also include calibratio n of relevant instruments once every year through an NABL-accredited laboratory only. The calibration certificate shall be submitted to the Institute after completion of calibration. 7.
